import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.next();
        int n = s.length();
        int atFlag = 0;
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();

        for (int idx = 0; idx < n; ) {
            if (idx == 0 && s.startsWith("at", idx)) {
                result.append("at");
                idx += 2;
            } else if (idx == 0 && s.startsWith("dot", idx)) {
                result.append("dot");
                idx += 3;
            } else if (idx == n - 2 && s.startsWith("at", idx)) {
                result.append("at");
                break;
            } else if (idx == n - 3 && s.startsWith("dot", idx)) {
                result.append("dot");
                break;
            } else if (s.startsWith("at", idx) && atFlag == 0) {
                result.append("@");
                atFlag = 1;
                idx += 2;
            } else if (s.startsWith("dot", idx)) {
                result.append(".");
                idx += 3;
            } else {
                result.append(s.charAt(idx));
                idx += 1;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(result.toString());
        sc.close();
    }
}
